facts.fact: ITWeb reports Seacom's 17,000km cable, launched in 2009, connects South Africa with Mozambique, Tanzania, Kenya, Djibouti, France and India; repairs after Red Sea breaks are noted as a cost, not a closure.

systems.owner: Seacom (Remgro 30%, IPS 30%, Sanlam 15%, Convergence Partners 15%, Brian Herlihy 10%)
